description: List correspondence filed in a matter, newest received first; filter by channel (email or data_box). When intake is not direct, from, to, and the message date (sentAt) are asserted by the forwarder and are not verified; authentication verdicts in authenticatedSender describe the delivery, not the extracted original. A record whose source is upload was read from the file sourceEntityId in the matter (an email file, or a data-box .zfo file); its headers are as stated in that file and are not verified. A data_box record carries its envelope in dataBox (message ID, sender and recipient box IDs, names and reference numbers, delivery and acceptance times); its from and to addresses are box IDs and its subject is the message annotation.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from a previous page to fetch the next page
